title: fix(plugin-grid): Tab leaves the import wizard's Save-current reason again
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9VieMHXiXxXWagiWddrZhjq)_

Fixes #33862

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Claim by `domain:ui#1`, card-thread session `session_01ADHkmQbwF4p3MGtT3JR5V3`.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：导入向导映射步骤里，「Save current」禁用原因的提示框（tooltip）改为渲染到 dialog 之外（portal 到 `document.body`）。原因 span 仍是可聚焦的 tab 停靠点，聚焦时照样弹出原因。
- 为什么改：一列都没映射时，在原因 span 上按 Tab，tooltip 随失焦卸载；它挂在 dialog 里面，dialog 的焦点陷阱把「失焦间隙里有节点被移除」误判为「焦点元素被删」，把焦点拉回 dialog 本身，键盘用户永远到不了映射下拉框、Next、Cancel、Back、Close。
- 风险与回滚：只动这一个 tooltip 的挂载位置（一行 portal），不改文案、不改禁用判定。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ImportWizard.tsx`（TemplateBar 的 `nothingMapped` 分支），`ui/e2e/import-wizard-keyboard-tab-order.spec.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec playwright test e2e/import-wizard-keyboard-tab-order.spec.ts --project=chromium`，预期 4 passed；把 `{createPortal(` 换回内联渲染，预期「nothing mapped」与 tooltip 两条转红，两条对照仍绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ImportWizard.tsx`** (TemplateBar, the `nothingMapped` branch): the reason tooltip's `TooltipContent` is rendered through `createPortal(…, document.body)` instead of inline. The focusable reason span, its `aria-describedby`, the `sr-only` reason and the tooltip text are unchanged, so the disabled-control reason stays reachable by keyboard and is still announced with the tooltip closed.

### Root cause

Focusing the reason span opens its tooltip, and `@object-ui/components`' `TooltipContent` mounts inline, so the content sat inside the dialog. Tab blurs the span, the tooltip closes and its content unmounts. In a native focus move Chromium runs microtasks between the blur and the focus, with `document.activeElement` on `body`; the dialog's Radix `FocusScope` (trapped) has a `MutationObserver` on its container that reads "a node under me was removed while focus is on body" as "the focused element was removed", and focuses the container. The browser then abandons the move. That is exactly the card's cycle: template select, reason span, dialog container.

Measured in Chromium before the fix (a probe observer on the dialog, removed after): the tooltip node was inside the dialog (`tipInsideDialog: true`), the one removal on Tab was the tooltip text "Map at least one column to save a template.", and focus ended on the dialog. Next's own reason span draws no tooltip, which is why it never trapped (the card's third control).

### Other disabled-with-reason controls with the same wrapper

The trap needs both halves: a reason wrapper whose tooltip mounts inline, and a trapped focus scope (a modal Dialog, Sheet or AlertDialog) around it.

- Next's reason span in this wizard: inside the dialog, no tooltip, no trap (control below, green).
- The other sites of the `tabIndex={0}` tooltip wrapper, read statically: `DeclaredActionsBar`, `record-quick-actions`, `containers.tsx`, `ObjectValidationsPanel`, `FlowLedgerSwitch`, the inspectors' `_shared` and `ObjectFieldInspector`, `HomePage`, and the wrappers in `StudioDesignSurface` and `MarketplacePackagePage` (both files hold dialogs, but the wrappers are outside the dialog contents). None sits inside a modal dialog, so none has this trap; that matches the card's QA pass, which reached Archive, Publish, the field inspector rail, the validation body, the Properties group and Reassign….
- `DisabledReasonTrigger` (`@object-ui/components`, the four `action:*` renderers) is the one site whose placement metadata decides: an action with a declared `disabled` predicate rendered inside a modal dialog would meet the same trap. Not measured.

## Tests

- **New: `ui/e2e/import-wizard-keyboard-tab-order.spec.ts`** (runs in `Build & E2E UI`, chromium). It bundles the real `ImportWizard` from source with Vite (the harness shape of `e2e/dashboard-metric-tile-height.spec.ts`), opens it on a CSV through `initialFile`, clicks the dialog title, then presses Chromium's own Tab and Shift+Tab and names the focused stop after each press. Nothing calls `.focus()`.
  - nothing mapped (`foo,bar`): Tab visits the 8 stops in DOM order (template select, Save-current reason span, both mapping selects, Cancel, Back, Next reason span, Close) and loops to the first; Shift+Tab walks them back.
  - CONTROL `title,project` (Save current enabled, no wrapper) and CONTROL `title,foo` (only Next's reason span): the same walks, green before and after the fix.
  - the Save-current reason span is reached by keyboard, its tooltip reads the reason, and the next Tab moves on to the first mapping select.
- **Why not a vitest pin.** The microtask checkpoint between blur and focus exists only in a native focus move. `user-event`'s Tab in happy-dom moves focus with a scripted `.focus()`, so the mutation is observed after focus already sits on the next stop. Measured on the defect: a happy-dom `user-event` walk visited all 8 stops, so a vitest pin of this cannot go red. The spec header says this.
- **Ablation** (fix committed first; `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor `{createPortal(` hit 1 → 0, replacement rendering the content inline hit 0 → 1, blob `8c3f781e0f72` → `0d5bd53b2bd1`): nothing-mapped case and tooltip case **red** with the card's cycle (`import-template-select`, `reason:import-template-save-btn`, `dialog`, …), both controls green. Restore proven: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- No existing test was edited.

## Acceptance notes

- The generic class is wider than this control: any node that a blur removes under a trapped Radix `FocusScope` reads to the trap as the focused element removed, and every inline `TooltipContent` with a focusable trigger inside a modal dialog is one such node. This PR fixes the card's control only; the class-wide options are in the os-dev report on the card for the seat.
- The e2e lane's `webServer` serves the console build; this spec mounts its own page at a routed origin and does not read it.
